prompt: Finance reports that invoice totals occasionally disagree with the sum of their tax lines by one cent. The rounding in src/money.js is not applied consistently across the module's functions. Make the rounding consistent, and make allocate() distribute a total across weights so the parts always sum exactly back to the original amount. Do not change the existing rounding convention that the module already establishes. Run `node test/money.test.js` to check your work.
success_criteria: All rounding in the module uses the same convention
The established convention is preserved rather than replaced
allocate distributes an amount so the parts sum exactly to the input
Negative amounts round consistently with positive ones
